claims: NASA's Artemis II mission officially launched on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II is the first crewed mission to the Moon since 1972.
The crew of Artemis II consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
Reid Wiseman is a NASA astronaut.
Victor Glover is a NASA astronaut.
Christina Koch is a NASA astronaut.
Jeremy Hansen is a Canadian Space Agency astronaut.
The Artemis II crew will orbit the Moon in the Orion capsule.
Artemis II tests systems for future lunar landings and Mars exploration.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
The SLS rocket launches from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
The mission goal of Artemis II is a 10-day crewed around-the-Moon journey (flyby).
Artemis II tests the Orion spacecraft’s systems in deep space.
Artemis II is the first crewed lunar mission since Apollo 17 in 1972.
The Artemis program aims for a lunar landing around 2028.
The Artemis II mission includes studying the Moon's polar ice for future water, oxygen, and fuel production, according to a recent BBC report.
